scope: Owner-approved Expressive World native iOS follow-up after the Luminous Tide checkpoint.
implemented: Original bundled light/day coast, matching dark/night coast and focus sanctuary; no runtime generation or download.
Today scene with saved enabled companion, naturally growing protected text area, factual progress and one finite successful-save reaction.
Stronger nine-theme atmosphere and opaque symbol-identity habit cards; explicit Log/Undo unchanged.
Habit detail and calendars use distinct compositions, readable dates and canonical daily-success ribbons; Home activity intensity remains recorded effort.
Make Room shows suggested/saved target or the actual selected active-session countdown, with the saved companion only when enabled.
Six illustrated onboarding stages, explicit creation/permission actions and separated Continue/Skip at normal/largest text.
Weekly editorial Insights, selectable independent-week and captured-unit bars, session outcome stacks and annual recorded-activity atlas.
History and Settings use compact editorial headers and separate decorative scenery.
Bounded motion; Reduce Motion, Increase Contrast, Reduce Transparency and larger-text alternatives implemented.
preserved_boundaries: No new model, repository, calculator, schema, entitlement, permission, backend or third-party package.
No runtime AI; all reports remain factual canonical calculations with existing eligibility/cohort/skip/pause semantics.
Exact-record and stale-context Undo guards retained. Focus elapsed time never verifies concentration or completes a habit.
Companion visibility/selection and feedback preferences remain authoritative; no care loop or currency.
Artwork is hidden from accessibility and cannot intercept input. Share content and consent remain unchanged.

artwork.usage: Decorative only; native labels and values are separate.

verification.native_audits: Unsuppressed hit-region, text-clipping, traits and element descriptions on affected core/supporting screens; palette contrast is a separate unit regression.
verification.appearance: Actual simulator light/dark appearance; selected flows at largest Dynamic Type.
verification.launch_metric: Five-iteration responsive launch measurement is descriptive simulator data with high variance; no hardware or improvement claim.
verification.independent_code_review: No actionable material data, Undo, availability, overlay-hit-testing or unbounded-motion regression found.

previews.pngs: Unmodified native PNG bytes and dimensions, with per-file hashes and source test identifiers. Fictional verification data only.
previews.video_description: 15-second scaled/compressed excerpt of an actual native simulator onboarding recording; manual playback, no loop. Not a performance benchmark.

builds.debug: Native build-for-testing and rebuilt affected UI runs passed.

signed_phone.harness: Fresh temporary copy of the current project, with only main-app Watch embedding/dependency omitted. Current source/resource references and other settings preserved.
signed_phone.installation_outcome: devicectl confirmed success over paired connection.
signed_phone.automatic_foreground_launch: Not established: subsequent CoreDevice process launch failed to allocate an RSD device. Open Rilova manually.
signed_phone.data_operations: No uninstall, reset, seed or automated tests against the owner phone.

owner_simulator.data_operations: Install only; no uninstall, reset, seed or automated tests against the owner simulator.

remaining_manual_gates: Hands-on physical VoiceOver/focus order, haptics, OLED/Always-On, sustained animation and device performance review.
Older supported iOS/device layouts and accessibility-setting combinations require hands-on release review beyond the executed simulator flows.
Existing signed Health, notification, Siri, Screen Time, StoreKit, Watch and optional private iCloud authorization/lifecycle checks.
Existing distribution entitlements, production configuration and TestFlight/App Store review gates are separate from a successful development build.
Existing users retain completed onboarding; the new sequence is not forced on update. Review it in the gallery or a deliberately separate fresh QA store.
